stem: A retail pharmacy uses an approved ADD as an emergency medication kit. Which loader/drug combinations comply with the Massachusetts loading rule? Select all that apply.

explanation.core_reasoning: In an emergency-kit ADD, an ordinary technician is limited to III-VI, while certified technicians and interns may load C-II under the policy.

choice_analysis.A: Certified technicians are listed loaders without the ordinary-tech III-VI limitation.
choice_analysis.C: Ordinary technicians may load Schedule III-VI.
choice_analysis.D: Schedule VI is within the ordinary-tech emergency-kit range.
choice_analysis.E: Schedule II is outside the ordinary-tech range.

related_facts: A pharmacist and licensed nurse are also listed emergency-kit loaders.
explanation.mpje_trap: Assuming every technician credential has the same Schedule II authority.

reasoning_steps: Identify emergency-kit ADD rather than routine dispensing
